title: Why Is Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) in Semiconductor Cleaning Dangerous? How HF Burns Work and First Aid with Calcium Gluconate
excerpt: Learn about the safety of hydrofluoric acid used in semiconductor cleaning. This Cleaning Level 3 lesson gently explains why HF is considered dangerous even when it barely hurts, the basic steps if it gets on your body, and what to prepare in advance. It also includes a word review and common misconceptions.
